Make type carry the kiln idea: set the section stamps' codes, the story step numbers and the stat rail (4.9 / 164 / 18) in one pressed, tabular DM Mono treatment cut into the brick face, and retire the loose tracked-caps runs (kicker, legend, proof line) into that single stamped voice; pair it with one oversized Young Serif moment per dark band so the display/mono contrast is the system, not ornament.
